Available Summer 2024 · £100pppw · Great Location

Acorn Properties are delighted to welcome this four-bedroom student property available to three people on the edge of Heaton Park. Comprising of hallway, modern fitted kitchen with appliances, three double bedrooms and a smaller fourth bedroom or study-room, two spacious bathrooms, full central heating, double-glazing, private rear yard. Great location, close to local amenities, good access to Northumbria and Newcastle Uni's as well as Coach Lane Campus. To arrange your viewing contact My Property Box.
